name: Allosaurus
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +5. Passive Perception 15. Languages none.
appearance: A long-legged bipedal predator with ochre-brown scales, low ridges above its eyes, clawed forelimbs, and a long balancing tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 116.
sections.Traits: Pounce. Move at least 30 ft. straight toward a creature and hit it with Claw that turn. The target must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone. If that target is prone, the allosaurus can make one Bite attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

name: Ankylosaurus
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 11. Languages none.
appearance: A low four-legged dinosaur with a broad beaked head, rounded armor plates, and a heavy bony club at the tip of its tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 117.
sections.Actions: Tail. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit for 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit by the tail must pass a DC 14 Strength save or fall prone.

name: Black Bear
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: A black-furred bear with rounded ears, a cinnamon-brown muzzle, and a gently rounded back.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 119.
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on scent.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
